title: The Dutch government says it will resist the US' planned Match Act, which aims to restrict ASML's sales to China, calling the proposal a threat to the company (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: The Dutch government says it will resist the US' planned Match Act, which aims to restrict ASML's sales to China, calling the proposal a threat to the company — The Dutch government said it will resist US plans to further restrict ASML Holding NV's sales to China, calling the proposed rules a threat to Europe's most valuable company.
